'''Herglic algae ice cream''' was a dessert created by the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]]. The [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream's]] main ingredient was [[Algae/Legends|algae]]. Herglic algae ice cream was served at the annual [[Vor-cal Feast]] held aboard the [[House Melantha Orbital Hunting Lodge]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vycinyth]].<ref name="LE" />
